reviews.author: Leandro Coppi
reviews.quote: Everything is done with a lot of technique, but without excess. Music with class, heaviness and subtlety.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Tudo é feito com muita técnica, mas sem exagero. Música com classe, peso e sutileza.
reviews.summary: A short, very positive review in issue #207 of Brazil's leading metal magazine. It praises the band's technique and restraint. The same year, readers nominated the album for Best National Album in the magazine's poll.

reviews.author: Thamy Melo
reviews.quote: Has become a great promise of São Paulo metal with its excellent debut album, which surprises with its high quality coming from an extremely new band.
reviews.quoteOriginal: se tornou uma grande promessa do Metal paulista com seu ótimo álbum de estreia, Insane Driver, que surpreende pela alta qualidade vinda de uma banda extremamente nova.
reviews.summary: An enthusiastic review that hears heavy metal at the core, with measured doses of metalcore, post-grunge, hard rock and prog. It singles out the backing vocals and the rhythm section and closes by saying Brazilian metal still has a lot of gas to burn.

reviews.author: Marcos Garcia
reviews.quote: Insane Driver arrives at a good moment, standing out from the common ground and bringing something new, alive and fresh. Welcome, and please, stay!
reviews.quoteOriginal: o INSANE DRIVER chega em um bom momento, destoando do ponto comum de muitos e trazendo algo novo, vivo e cheio de frescor. Sejam bem vindo, e por favor, fiquem!
reviews.summary: Highly positive. It praises the blend of traditional metal, metalcore and touches of grunge, groove and rock'n'roll, the production by Tiago Oliveira and Rua D, and the artwork. Highlights: "The Edge of Life", "Tide of Fears", "Buried Thoughts" and "Tears of Blood".

reviews.author: Junior Frascá
reviews.quote: With this first album, Insane Driver already shows itself to be one of the great revelations of the Brazilian scene.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Nesse seu primeiro álbum, o INSANE DRIVER, banda da capital paulista, já dá mostrar de ser uma das grandes revelações do cenário nacional
reviews.summary: Positive. It describes modern, heavy and melodic metal with traditional roots and praises Tiago Oliveira's production. It predicts the band will become a reference of contemporary Brazilian metal if it keeps to its bold path, and picks "Today Is Sunday" as the heaviest track.

reviews.author: Flávio Diniz
reviews.quote: Amateurism didn't come anywhere near this. It's a very well produced and performed album. Intelligent and experienced.
reviews.quoteOriginal: O amadorismo não passou nem perto aqui. [...] É um álbum muito bem produzido e executado. Inteligente e experiente.
reviews.summary: Very positive. It praises the professional production, the interplay of guitars and bass, the varied vocals and the artwork, and calls the band creative and unusual on the scene.

reviews.author: João Messias Jr.
reviews.quote: Strong, explosive and urgent! That's how Insane Driver's first album can be defined.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Forte, explosivo e urgente! Assim se define o primeiro álbum da banda Insane Driver.
reviews.summary: Positive. It points to Dream Theater, Metallica, John Bush-era Anthrax and Alter Bridge as reference points and says the long songs never get tiring. It praises the production and graphic design.

reviews.author: Marcelo Lopes Vieira
reviews.quote: What an album! What energy! Modern heavy rock with a well-crafted sound, great riffs and sticky choruses.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Que álbum! Que energia! [...] resultando num Heavy Rock moderno, de sonoridade 'trampada', ótimos riffs, refrões grudentos
reviews.summary: Highly positive. It compares the band to Metallica, Black Label Society, Disturbed, Testament and Megadeth while stressing its own personality, and calls the album an almost-polished musical diamond. It praises the vocals, the riffs, the drums and the CD packaging.

reviews.author: Cristiano Borges
reviews.quote: Those who follow the traditional side of metal won't like it, but those who enjoy a modern, melody-filled sound will have a blast!
reviews.quoteOriginal: Quem seguem o lado tradicional do metal não vai se agradar mas que curte um som moderno e cheios de melodias vai se esbaldar!
reviews.summary: Positive, with a caveat for metal traditionalists. It notes the groove, thrash and melodic passages, the Hetfield-like vocals and the professional approach, and highlights the cover art.

reviews.author: Magnum Watts
reviews.quote: Insane Driver already stands out as one of the great revelations of the year.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Insane Driver já desponta como uma das grandes revelações do ano.
reviews.summary: A positive review published on Metal na Lata's social channels. It names the debut one of the revelations of 2016; the quote and score are preserved in the band's 2016 press release.

reviews.author: Sergiomar Menezes
reviews.quote: A band with a brilliant future (and why not say, a brilliant present) that has everything it takes to rank among the great names of Brazilian metal.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Uma banda que tem um futuro (e porque não dizer, um presente) brilhante e que tem tudo para figurar entre os grandes nomes do metal brasileiro.
reviews.summary: A detailed track-by-track rave that calls the album one of the highlights of 2016. It praises the clean but heavy production, the guitar duo and the bass and drums partnership, and singles out "Change" and "Buried Thoughts".

reviews.author: Renato Sanson
reviews.quote: Musically complicated? Maybe, but with each listen the album wins you over more and you discover new elements. A fine debut and a very promising future.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Musicalmente complicado? Até pode ser, mas a cada ouvida o disco te ganha cada vez mais e você descobre novos elementos. Uma bela estreia e um futuro muito promissor.
reviews.summary: Positive. It hears a hard-to-label but cohesive mix of hardcore, prog, metal and alternative metal where feeling wins over technique. It praises the modern, unartificial production and the artwork.

reviews.author: Écio Souza Diniz
reviews.quote: The album's great trick is how they use excellent technique to combine melodies with stronger, heavier, more energetic passages.
reviews.quoteOriginal: a grande sacada do álbum é forma com a qual fazem uso de uma ótima técnica para a combinação de melodias com passagens de pegada mais forte, pesada e energética.
reviews.summary: Positive. It hears a modern sound that keeps classic Metallica and Pantera traits and recommends the album. Its one criticism: the gang vocals and slow-downs, as in "Faithless Breath", are sometimes a bit much.

reviews.author: Écio Souza Diniz
reviews.quote: If you like a harmonious blend of different metal styles combining technique and feeling, Silicon Fortress will give you good times.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Se você gosta de uma mescla de distintos estilos do metal feita em harmonia na combinação entre técnica e feeling, Silicon Fortress vai te proporcionar bons momentos.
reviews.summary: A very positive pre-release review that hears technical and sonic evolution and a stronger metalcore side. It highlights the opening trio, the groove of "Age of Lies", the In Flames-like "Ghosts" and the breakdowns of "Imagined Realities".

reviews.author: Renato Sanson
reviews.quote: Practically a lyrical dystopia that would fit very well as a soundtrack to the classic Blade Runner.
reviews.quoteOriginal: Praticamente uma distopia lírica que caberia muito bem como trilha sonora do clássico Blade Runner.
reviews.summary: Very positive. It calls the album excellent: more melodic and more aggressive than the debut, with high-level progressive nuances. It praises new vocalist Eder Franco, the technology concept, the production and the cover art.

reviews.author: Maykon Kjellin
reviews.quote: If I had to choose the surest formula, I'd bet on what Insane Driver brought on the new album: explosion, drive, guitar riffs, good vocals and a heavy rhythm section.
reviews.quoteOriginal: se fosse para escolher uma fórmula mais certeira, apostaria no que o Insane Driver trouxe no novo disco. Explosão, impulsão, riffs de guitarra, bons vocais e cozinha pesada.
reviews.summary: Positive. It hears heavy metal with post-grunge touches and metalcore and prog influences, with more riff-driven guitars than the debut. It calls the production, mixing and mastering impeccable.

reviews.author: Caio Siqueira Iocohama
reviews.quote: Absurd riff, excellent drums, Zakk Wylde-style harmonics, perfect vocals. The guys are really very good at what they do!
reviews.quoteOriginal: Riff absurdo, bateria excelente, harmônicos ao estilo Zakk Wylde, vocal perfeito [...] Os caras são muito bons no que fazem MESMO!
reviews.summary: Positive. It praises the band's identity and modern blend of heavy metal, metalcore and post-grunge, with "Insane Driver" and "Imagined Realities" as highlights. It finds that the melodic passages of "Age of Lies" and "Distant Hearts" dilute the weight.

reviews.quote: The band experimented more this time, blending interesting elements and delivering an above-average result in a style where it's hard to stand out.
reviews.quoteOriginal: a banda experimentou mais dessa vez, mesclando elementos interessantes e entregando um resultado acima da média em um estilo difícil de se destacar.
reviews.summary: Positive and detailed. It finds the album more introspective and more mature than the debut, reads the cover as an allegory of social media, and credits Danilo Pozzani's production. It says fans of Metallica's Black Album will headbang to "Insane Driver".

reviews.author: Sergiomar Menezes
reviews.quote: Silicon Fortress is an excellent work, showing that Insane Driver deserves a better position in the Brazilian heavy music scene.
reviews.quoteOriginal: SILICON FORTRESS é um excelente trabalho, mostrando que o INSANE DRIVER merece uma melhor colocação dentro do cenário da música pesada brasileira.
reviews.summary: A track-by-track rave that says the band surpassed the promise of its debut. It praises Pozzani's clean production and Eder Franco's unique timbre, and calls "Ghosts" a power ballad and "Distant Hearts" a true ballad.
